findings.title: Keep portable network clone routing independent from ambient URL rewrites
findings.trigger: User imports a public HTTPS/SSH repository and clones with a ready profile while user-global/profile-included or destination-parent config has url.<other host>.insteadOf for that source.
findings.behavior: Network setup_clone uses repository_command and retains complete global/profile and parent config. The environment cleanup resets GIT_CONFIG_COUNT but does not remove url.*.insteadOf. Git silently routes the imported URL to another host or repository, contrary to preview and requested isolation; selected-host account helpers may no longer apply.
findings.evidence: network-rewrite-reproducer.json: expected https://expected.fixture.invalid/team/project.git invokes recording fake SSH for git@redirect.fixture.invalid. No real network or credentials used.
findings.recommendation: Build network clone from isolated base configuration and add only the captured ready profile authentication/SSH settings needed for the selected transport/host, or reject effective URL changes before transport. Add actual network-command recording regression with synthetic global and parent URL rewrites.

findings.title: Compare worktree lock paths using filesystem identity on Windows
findings.trigger: Windows import restores a locked linked worktree, then a later worktree step fails. User retries retained partial outcome.
findings.behavior: Rust parent.canonicalize yields Windows native/verbatim paths, while Git worktree porcelain emits slash paths. Raw byte equality misses the existing locked entry, then worktree lock runs again and Git errors already locked. Retry stops before later unfinished worktrees.
findings.evidence: windows-lock-review.json: existing project src/git/worktree.rs:242 models C:/... porcelain; synthetic Windows canonical versus Git spellings fail b05 comparison; independent owned Linux Git confirms second lock exits128 already locked. Native Windows runtime not claimed.
findings.recommendation: Resolve porcelain path to Path and compare canonical filesystem identity/normalized Windows forms rather than raw display bytes. Cover locked worktree before a later failure and successful unchanged receipt retry; retain native Windows final gate.
